verdict.summary: Round 3 remains correct and complete. The catalog generator is byte-identical to its committed primary artifact, Q16 remains an explicit empty-member gap guarded against accidental coverage without a path_reach_d1_* member, and Q17/Q18 remain machine-flagged bounded partial coverage rather than unbounded SPARQL coverage. The focused tests exercise those catalog invariants, while the dispatch implementation confirms p? fixes depth at 1 and p+/p* expose no fixed depth. The claims remain consistent with the normative bounded, existence-only design statement and retain the external-audit caveat. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, security, or claim-honesty issue is present.
